cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(Dissidia012 VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(PORTABLEKIT_ROOT "" CACHE PATH
    "Path to PortableKit source directory (e.g. path/to/Tenkawa/portablekit)")
if(NOT PORTABLEKIT_ROOT OR NOT EXISTS "${PORTABLEKIT_ROOT}/cmake/PortableKit.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set PORTABLEKIT_ROOT to the PortableKit source directory")
endif()

set(D012_PROFILE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../d012")

# Embedded assets: generated by the legacy d012 build, or set D012_EMBED_DIR manually.
set(D012_EMBED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/../d012/profiles/d012/embedded6"
    CACHE PATH "Directory containing pre-generated d012_embedded_assets_v2.cpp/.hpp")
set(D012_EMBED_CPP "${D012_EMBED_DIR}/d012_embedded_assets_v2.cpp")
set(D012_EMBED_HPP "${D012_EMBED_DIR}/d012_embedded_assets_v2.hpp")
if(NOT EXISTS "${D012_EMBED_HPP}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "Embedded assets not found at ${D012_EMBED_DIR}.\n"
        "Build the legacy d012 target first, or set D012_EMBED_DIR to the directory "
        "containing d012_embedded_assets_v2.hpp.")
endif()

add_subdirectory("${PORTABLEKIT_ROOT}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/portablekit")

portablekit_add_game(d012_native
    PROFILE_DIR "${D012_PROFILE_DIR}"
    SOURCES host/d012_portablekit_profile.cpp)

# Generated units include d012_profile.hpp, win32_display.hpp, ge_render.hpp,
# and d012_embedded_assets_v2.hpp — expose those directories.
target_include_directories(d012_native_generated PRIVATE
    "${D012_PROFILE_DIR}/host"
    "${D012_EMBED_DIR}"
)
target_include_directories(d012_native PRIVATE
    "${D012_PROFILE_DIR}/host"
    "${D012_EMBED_DIR}"
)

# Overlay menu generated units (portablekit_add_game only globs generated/*.cpp)
file(GLOB D012_OVL_MENU CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${D012_PROFILE_DIR}/generated/overlay_menu/*.cpp")
if(D012_OVL_MENU)
    if(MSVC)
        set_source_files_properties(${D012_OVL_MENU} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "/Od;/Ob0;/bigobj")
    endif()
    target_sources(d012_native_generated PRIVATE ${D012_OVL_MENU})
    target_include_directories(d012_native_generated PRIVATE
        "${D012_PROFILE_DIR}/generated/overlay_menu")
endif()

# Host sources the generated units call into
target_sources(d012_native PRIVATE
    "${D012_EMBED_CPP}"
    "${D012_PROFILE_DIR}/host/d012_profile.cpp"
    "${D012_PROFILE_DIR}/host/ge_render.cpp"
    "${D012_PROFILE_DIR}/host/win32_display.cpp"
)

if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(d012_native PRIVATE winmm gdi32 user32)
endif()
